# Kenyan Magazine

> > Kenyan Magazine is a comprehensive lifestyle and education resource covering Kenyan universities, technical colleges, mobile money services like M-Pesa and Safaricom, health tips, entertainment, and practical guides for daily life in Kenya.

The magazine serves as a digital hub for Kenyans seeking information on higher education institutions (CHRM, Kisii University, Mount Kenya University), telecommunications services (Safaricom customer care, Okoa Stima), financial services (Zenka loans, M-PESA), and lifestyle content ranging from health advice to entertainment news.

## Key Topics

- Kenya
- Kenyan Education
- Safaricom
- M-Pesa
- Nairobi
- College of Human Resource Management (CHRM)
- Diploma Courses
- Certificate Courses
- Degree Programs
- University Courses
- Technical Training
- ICDL (International Computer Driving Licence)
- CHRP (Certified Human Resource Professional)
- Higher Education
- Mobile Money Services

## Telecommunications & Mobile Services

- [Safaricom Customer Care Number and Contacts](https://kenyanmagazine.co.ke/safaricom-customer-care-number-and-contacts): Safaricom customer care numbers, M-PESA support & Nairobi contacts
- [Safaricom Okoa Stima: How To Get Free Electricity](https://kenyanmagazine.co.ke/safaricom-okoa-stima-how-to-get-free-electricity-using-okoa-stima): Okoa Stima registration guide for emergency KPLC electricity tokens
- [Zenka Loan App: How To Repay Your Loan](https://kenyanmagazine.co.ke/zenka-loan-app-how-to-repay-your-loan-via-mpesa-ussd-and-zenka-app): Guide to repaying Zenka loans via M-PESA, USSD codes & app

## Universities & Higher Education

- [College of Human Resource Management (CHRM) Courses](https://kenyanmagazine.co.ke/college-of-human-resource-management): CHRM Nairobi courses, diplomas, certificates & contact information

- [Mount Kenya University Courses](https://kenyanmagazine.co.ke/mount-kenya-university): Mount Kenya University Thika degree programs & course catalog
- [Riara University Courses](https://kenyanmagazine.co.ke/riara-university): Riara University Nairobi courses including CCNA & contact info
- [Oshwal College Courses](https://kenyanmagazine.co.ke/oshwal-college): Oshwal College certificates, diplomas, degrees & CFA programs listed
